description: This file defines the 'Config' class within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, including nested classes for configuration management, JSON serialization, environment variables, and path substitution. It manages configuration parameters for a server, including paths, network settings, plugin configurations, and security. It also provides methods for updating network bindings, substituting variables in paths, and accessing configuration data.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class managing server settings, paths, network, plugins, and security.

classes.name: Config::InputInfo
classes.description: Holds input device configuration details such as locator, type, and enabled status.

classes.name: Config::ProcessInfo
classes.description: Stores process-related configuration such as user, group, priority, and policy.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig
classes.description: JSON serializable container for server configuration parameters, paths, network, and plugin settings.

classes.name: Config::Environment
classes.description: Represents environment variable key-value pairs with override option.

classes.name: Config::ProcessSet
classes.description: Defines process execution parameters including user, group, priority, and policy.

classes.name: Config::InputConfig
classes.description: Configuration for input devices, including locator, type, and output enable flag.

classes.name: Config::Observables
classes.description: Holds paths for proxy stub and plugin configuration.

classes.name: Config::ProcessContainerConfig
classes.description: Configuration for process containers, including logging level.

classes.name: Config::HibernateConfig
classes.description: Configuration for Hibernate support, including locator address.

methods.name: Config::UpdateBinder
methods.description: Updates network binding address based on interface and binding settings.

methods.name: Config::Security
methods.description: Sets the security interface for the configuration.

methods.name: Config::Substitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution in path strings using configured variables.

methods.name: Config::Add
methods.description: Adds a plugin configuration if not already present.

methods.name: Config::Plugins
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the plugin configurations.

methods.name: Config::LinkerPluginPaths
methods.description: Returns the list of linker plugin paths.

methods.name: Config::UpdateAccessor
methods.description: Resolves and updates the network address for server access.

methods.name: Config::Security
methods.description: Assigns a security object to the configuration.
